title: Putting It All Together
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Unit synthesis across bonding diagrams, formulas, nomenclature tables, and property data. Use only assigned Unit 3 evidence; no chemical synthesis is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for bonding models, molecular geometry, ionic/covalent comparisons, and intermolecular forces
simulationVirtualLabReviewFocus: Unit synthesis across bonding, formulas, compounds, and nomenclature
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the model-building screen with a central atom. Add bonded atoms one at a time, then add lone pairs if the lesson model calls for them. Observe how each added electron domain changes the three-dimensional shape. Record the number of bonded atoms, number of lone pairs, shape name or visual description, and how the model supports Putting It All Together.
